tiers.name: Warm-up
tiers.description: Two operations. Multiply or divide before you add or subtract.

tiers.name: Exponents
tiers.description: Exponents come before multiplying, dividing, adding and subtracting.

tiers.name: Boss Level
tiers.description: Four or more steps, nested parentheses, all operations.

LTR.student: Worked left to right. Do × and ÷ before + and −.
LTR.teacher: Evaluates strictly left to right, ignoring precedence.

ADD_FIRST.student: Added or subtracted too early. × and ÷ come first.

IGNORE_PARENS.student: Skipped the parentheses. Do what's inside them first.
IGNORE_PARENS.teacher: Ignores grouping symbols and applies normal precedence to the flat expression.

EXP_AFTER_MULT.student: Exponent goes on its base only, before multiplying.
EXP_AFTER_MULT.teacher: Evaluates exponents after multiplication/division, e.g. 2 × 3^2 as (2 × 3)^2.

M_BEFORE_D.student: × and ÷ are a team: go left to right between them.
M_BEFORE_D.teacher: Reads PEMDAS literally and multiplies before dividing regardless of position.

A_BEFORE_S.student: + and − are a team: go left to right between them.
A_BEFORE_S.teacher: Reads PEMDAS literally and adds before subtracting regardless of position.
